timeline.title: A Short History of Celebrating Mum
items: In England, young people working away were given a day off to go home to their mothers, often with flowers picked on the way.
Julia Ward Howe wrote a Mother's Day Proclamation, asking mothers everywhere to unite for peace.
Anna Jarvis held a service for her own mother and handed out carnations, her mother's favourite flower.
Mother's Day became a national holiday in the United States, and the idea spread around the world.
today: Not in the history books yet. But to us, the most important mum who ever lived.

letters.title: What the World Has Said About Mums
items: Mother is the name for God in the lips and hearts of little children.
A mother is the truest friend we have.
A mother's love for her child is like nothing else in the world.
An ounce of mother is worth a pound of clergy.
letters.hand: They all say it beautifully. We just say: thank you, {who}.

facts.title: The Science of a Mother's Love
items: Babies can recognise their mother's voice before they are even born.
Newborns can pick out their mother's face from others within days of birth.
Just hearing mum's voice can lower a child's stress and release oxytocin, the cuddle hormone.
A few of a child's cells can stay in their mother's body for decades. Scientists call it microchimerism.
Babies begin smiling back at the people who love them at around six weeks old.
In a baby's first year, mums give up hundreds of hours of sleep. Most would do it all again.
facts.hand: Science can explain a lot. It still cannot explain how {who} always knows.

world.kicker: A thank you from all of us
world.title: Why the World Is Better With You in It
world.lead: Because of you, the world got:
items: A hug that fixes almost anything.
Someone who always saves the last slice for us.
The wisest advice, given at exactly the right time.
A kitchen full of laughter and good food.
A kindness that spreads to everyone you meet.
A home we always want to come back to.
And the best mum we could ever have asked for.
world.close: The world is better because of you, {who}. Ours most of all.

promises.title: Our promises to you
items: To call you just to say hello.
To remember everything you taught us.
To say thank you more often.
To make you as proud as you make us.
To love you, always, wherever we are.

note.title: What we believe a mum is
paras: We make magazines for a living, but some feel different. This was one of them.
We believe a mum is not only the big moments. She is the packed lunch, the plaster on a knee, the light left on, the voice on the phone that makes everything feel smaller and more possible.
{who}, someone wanted you to have something special. Not a card anyone could buy, but pages full of you: your face, your words, the little things that make you, you.
That someone is {from}. And from everything they told us, you are loved more than you could ever know.
